note: Independent re-audit against RFC 8671 Section 5.2 ('The L flag MUST be set to 0 to indicate pre-policy') at HEAD. peerHeaderFromEvent (bmp_events.go) sets PeerFlagO and clears PeerFlagL for EventKindUpdatePrePolicyOut; replayPeerLocked (bmp_replay.go) emits cached pre-policy routes and pre-policy Adj-RIB-Out EORs with O=1, L=0. Positive TestRFC8671PrePolicyAdjRIBOutSetsLFlagZero drives reload enabling adj-rib-out-pre-policy (asserting bounced pre-policy EOR has PeerFlagO), live handleStructuredEvent over net.Pipe (asserting O=1, L=0, reserved=0), and primeSender replay (asserting replayed route carries O=1, L=0). Negative TestRFC8671PrePolicyAdjRIBOutDistinguishesFromPostPolicyAndDefaultOff verifies YANG default false, confirms disabled senders emit nothing for pre-policy Adj-RIB-Out, and confirms post-policy Adj-RIB-Out keeps O=1, L=1 and Adj-RIB-In keeps O=0, L=0 whether pre-policy out is off or on.
